description: Colloquial / conversational filler words — interjections, discourse markers, slang. Non-sensitive. On speech-to-text transcripts Natasha NER mistags capitalized fillers (sentence-initial "Угу", "Точно", "Короче") as PERSON or ORG; unlike the POS filter, an explicit stoplist also catches the ones the morph tagger labels PROPN. Matched as word-by-word lemma keys, so only a whole single-word span is dropped (a multi-word real entity containing such a word is unaffected). Does not — and cannot — cover ASR garbage (non-existent mis-transcribed words). To extend: add another conversational filler word. NOTE: does not list bare "да"/"нет" — too short to ever be a meaningful NER span and pointless to filter.
